description: The City of Edmonton publishes the tonnage of material sent from the Edmonton Waste Management Centre to landfills. Three documented fields identify the calendar year, destination landfill and mass in metric tons. This describes an annual flow between a waste-management facility and its disposal destinations. It can supply historical waste-flow quantities for disposal-capacity and waste-system simulation. The metadata does not establish the first or last observation year, transport routes, material composition, landfill design capacity or all waste generated within Edmonton. The reported data-update date is February 2024 and must not be substituted for an observation date. No inference about currently available landfill capacity follows from the transferred tonnage. The public portal and JSON catalogue metadata are free to access. The licence is See Terms of Use. Legacy CSV export checks returned HTTP 410; current distribution access remains unverified. No dataset rows were downloaded. Related records include the parent open-data catalogue for Edmonton.
